title: area
summary: Benilla publishes the zone identity (leaf -> single-hop parent zone), the ZONE_CHANGED/ZONE_CHANGED_NEW_AREA/ZONE_CHANGED_INDOORS election with the WMO-interior naming override (inn splash), the minimap subzone-else-zone line, and GetZonePVPInfo (friendly/hostile/contested + arena flag). MSUI loads AreaTable.dbc, resolves the terrain-chunk areaId per frame, draws the minimap zone-text line (subzone-else-zone) and sends CMSG_ZONEUPDATE on zone change - but the rest of the family is absent.

openItems.text: No zone-change splash: entering a new zone/subzone never shows the big center-screen ZoneTextFont/SubZoneTextFont text (both fonts are declared in FontObjectLaw.cs but nothing renders a splash).

No WMO-interior naming: indoors the area stays the terrain chunk's - a named interior (Lion's Pride Inn whole-WMO override, per-room subzones like Main Hall, the indoor/outdoor dedup) never replaces the zone/subzone texts.
No zone PvP info: friendly/hostile/contested ownership from the zone's FactionGroupMask vs the player's faction template (and the FFA-arena leaf flag) is not computed or displayed anywhere.
